name: ABeeZee
description: A friendly, rounded sans-serif with open letterforms, originally drawn with young readers in mind. Its soft shapes make it a warm choice for interfaces, children's content and casual body text.
copyright: Copyright 2011 The ABeeZee Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/abeezee), with Reserved Font Name 'ABeeZee'

name: Abel
description: A narrow, upright sans-serif with a clean, slightly technical feel. Its condensed width fits a lot of text into headlines, navigation and compact UI labels.
copyright: Copyright (c) 2011, Matthew Desmond (http://www.madtype.com | mattdesmond@gmail.com),with Reserved Font Name Abel.

name: Abhaya Libre
description: A serif family with five weights covering both Latin and Sinhala scripts. Its traditional book-style proportions suit long-form reading and editorial layouts.

name: Abril Fatface
description: A high-contrast display serif with heavy vertical strokes and hairline serifs. Built for big headlines, posters and magazine covers where it can be set large.
copyright: Copyright (c) 2011, TypeTogether (www.type-together.com), with Reserved Font Names "Abril" and "Abril Fatface"

name: Alfa Slab One
description: A heavy slab-serif display face with strong, blocky serifs. It makes an impact in short headlines, logos and packaging.
copyright: Copyright 2016 The Alfa Slab One Project Authors (http://www.jmsole.cl | info@jmsole.cl), with Reserved Font Name "Alfa Slab".

name: Alice
description: A gentle, old-style serif with a slightly quirky, storybook character. Works well for literary titles, invitations and short passages of text.

name: Allura
description: A formal, flowing script with elegant connecting strokes. Best used at larger sizes for invitations, greetings and decorative headings.

name: Amatic SC
designer: Vernon Adams, Ben Nathan, Thomas Jockin
description: A tall, narrow hand-drawn small-caps face in two weights. Its sketchy, informal look suits posters, menus and playful headings.
copyright: Copyright 2015 The Amatic SC Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/AmaticSC)

name: Archivo Black
description: A single, very heavy grotesque sans-serif. It gives headlines and short statements a bold, confident presence.
copyright: Copyright 2017 The Archivo Black Project Authors (https://github.com/Omnibus-Type/ArchivoBlack)

name: B612 Mono
designer: Nicolas Chauveau, Thomas Paillot, Jonathan Favre-Lamarine, Jean-Luc Vinot
description: A monospaced companion to the B612 family, a typeface originally developed for aircraft cockpit displays with legibility as its main goal. Comes in regular and bold, each with an italic.

name: Bangers
description: An energetic, all-caps comic-book display face with a forward lean. Ideal for bold callouts, comics and attention-grabbing titles.

name: Bebas Neue
description: A tall, condensed all-caps sans-serif that has become a staple for headlines. It stacks neatly in posters, banners and hero titles.

name: Belleza
description: A light, humanist sans-serif with subtle contrast inspired by fashion and editorial design. Suits refined headings and short body copy.

name: Black Ops One
description: A rugged, stencil-flavoured display face with angular details. Fits gaming, military-themed and industrial graphics.

name: Brawler
description: A sturdy text serif with compact proportions, designed to stay clear at small sizes. Available in regular and bold for news-style reading.

name: Bungee
description: A bold, blocky display face with vertical-sign energy, inspired by urban signage. Great for short, loud headlines and badges.

name: Cardo
description: A classical serif designed for scholarly work, with support for many historic and academic characters. Includes regular, italic and bold.

name: Courier Prime
description: A refined take on the classic typewriter monospace, tuned for screenplays and manuscripts. Includes regular, italic, bold and bold italic.
copyright: Copyright 2015 The Courier Prime Project Authors (https://github.com/quoteunquoteapps/CourierPrime).

name: Covered By Your Grace
description: A loose, marker-style handwriting face with a relaxed personal feel. Works for notes, annotations and informal headings.

name: Crimson Text
description: An old-style book serif in three weights with matching italics. Designed for comfortable long-form reading in print and on screen.
copyright: Copyright 2010 The Crimson Text Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/Crimson)

name: Cutive Mono
description: A light monospace with the flavour of classic typewriter type. Suits retro layouts, quotes and literary captions.

name: Didact Gothic
description: A simple, geometric sans-serif with single-storey letters that are easy to recognize. Good for learning materials and clear interface text.

name: DM Mono
description: A monospaced family in three weights with italics, drawn as a companion to DM Sans. Clean and low-contrast for code, data and UI details.
copyright: Copyright 2020 The DM Mono Project Authors (https://www.github.com/googlefonts/dm-mono)

name: Fira Mono
description: A monospaced member of the Fira family, originally designed for the Firefox OS interface. Available in regular, medium and bold for code and terminals.
copyright: Copyright (c) 2012-2013, The Mozilla Corporation and Telefonica S.A.

name: Gloria Hallelujah
description: A bouncy, comic-style handwriting face with a light-hearted, school-notebook feel. Great for playful headings and captions.

name: Great Vibes
description: A graceful connected script with long, looping strokes. Suited to wedding stationery, certificates and elegant titles.
copyright: Copyright 2015 The Great Vibes Pro Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/great-vibes)

name: Hind
description: A clean sans-serif in five weights supporting Latin and Devanagari. Its even texture works well for interfaces and running text.

name: Indie Flower
description: A round, friendly handwriting face with a relaxed, youthful look. A good fit for casual headings and personal projects.

name: Kalam
description: A handwriting face in three weights supporting Latin and Devanagari, with a natural pen-on-paper rhythm. Suits informal notes and headings.

name: Lobster
description: A bold connected script with a retro sign-painting feel. Widely used for logos, labels and nostalgic headlines.
copyright: Copyright 2010 The Lobster Project Authors (https://github.com/impallari/The-Lobster-Font), with Reserved Font Name "Lobster".

name: Major Mono Display
description: A monospaced display face with geometric construction and mixed case forms. Best used large for experimental titles and tech branding.
copyright: Copyright 2018 The Major Mono Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/majormono)

name: Old Standard TT
description: A serif revival of a late-19th-century book typeface, with high contrast and classical details. Includes regular, italic and bold.
copyright: Copyright 2011 The Old Standard Project Authors (amkryukov@gmail.com)

name: Pacifico
designer: Vernon Adams, Jacques Le Bailly, Botjo Nikoltchev, Ani Petrova
description: A casual brush script with a laid-back, surf-culture mood. Popular for logos, headlines and friendly branding.

name: Patrick Hand
description: A neat, readable handwriting face that stays clear even in longer passages. Works for comics, notes and friendly interfaces.

name: Poiret One
description: A light, geometric decorative face with an Art Deco character. Elegant at large sizes for titles and branding.
copyright: Copyright 2011 The Poiret One Project Authors (https://github.com/alexeiva/poiretone)

name: Prata
description: A high-contrast serif with sharp, elegant details. Best for headlines and short editorial text.

name: Puritan
description: A plain, highly readable sans-serif with regular and bold weights and matching italics. Designed for clear, unadorned body text.
copyright: Copyright (c) 1999-2010 Ben Weiner (ben@readingtype.org.uk), with Reserved Font Name Puritan

name: Questrial
description: A clean geometric sans-serif with a single, versatile weight. Fits modern interfaces, brand text and headings.

name: Rozha One
description: A heavy, high-contrast display serif supporting Latin and Devanagari. Makes striking headlines and posters.

name: Shadows Into Light
description: A light, neat handwriting face with a slightly slanted, airy look. Good for captions, notes and soft headings.

name: Shanti
description: A slightly quirky humanist sans-serif with a friendly, readable texture. Suits body text and approachable interfaces.

name: Shrikhand
description: A bold, curvy display face with a playful italic slant, supporting Latin and Gujarati. Brings energy to headlines and packaging.

name: Sorts Mill Goudy
description: A revival of Goudy Oldstyle with regular and italic styles. Its warm classical forms suit books and literary designs.

name: Space Mono
description: A geometric monospace with a distinctive retro-futuristic feel, in regular and bold with italics. Popular for code, headings and tech branding.
copyright: Copyright 2016 The Space Mono Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/spacemono)

name: Staatliches
description: A condensed all-caps display face with strong geometric shapes. Great for posters, headers and bold labels.

name: Syne Mono
description: An irregular, distinctive monospace from the Syne family with a raw, experimental feel. Best for art, culture and editorial projects.

name: Unna
description: A sturdy serif with a contemporary take on classical forms, in regular and bold with italics. Suits editorial text and headlines.

name: Varela Round
description: A rounded, friendly sans-serif with soft terminals. Works nicely for app interfaces, children's content and approachable brands.
copyright: Copyright 2023 The Varela Round Project Authors (https://github.com/alefalefalef/Varela-Round-Hebrew/), with Reserved Font Names 'Varela' and ‘Varela Round’.

name: VT323
description: A pixel-style monospace modelled on the look of a classic video terminal. Ideal for retro, gaming and terminal-inspired designs.

name: Xanh Mono
designer: Yellow Type, Lâm Bảo, Duy Dao
description: A monospace with an unusual, calligraphic serif flavour, in regular and italic. Brings character to headlines, quotes and editorial layouts.
